targets.name: pump spectral FWHM
targets.verification_rule: Resolved line or conservative upper bound; include instrument function and uncertainty

targets.name: total incident crystal pump power
targets.origin: S1 with new operational definition PC_cw + PC_ccw
targets.verification_rule: Adjustable operating range; calibrated two-direction sum, not source output power

targets.name: DOP at P1
targets.verification_rule: Calibrated Stokes measurement; estimate minus U >= lower

targets.name: M2 per principal axis
targets.verification_rule: Preference only; values above require adapted propagation and overlap model

targets.name: centre wavelength expanded uncertainty
targets.verification_rule: U with k=2; report air/vacuum convention

targets.name: spectrometer instrumental FWHM
targets.verification_rule: Characterize line spread function; no proof from pixel spacing alone

targets.name: absolute power relative expanded uncertainty
targets.verification_rule: k=2 at actual wavelength and measurement plane

targets.name: beam diameter relative expanded uncertainty
targets.verification_rule: k=2; D4sigma plus background/ROI/pixel calibration

targets.name: M2 relative expanded uncertainty
targets.verification_rule: k=2; fit covariance and systematic effects

targets.name: relative power-change expanded uncertainty
targets.verification_rule: k=2 for change relative to prefrozen setpoint, shared calibration correlations included

targets.name: raw visibility HV and DA
targets.verification_rule: Separate calibration scan, equal exposure, no background subtraction, uncertainty reported

targets.name: unique pairs per setting
targets.verification_rule: Four settings each 600 s; 20 x 4 x 30 s total; no post-hoc extension

targets.name: relative electrical jitter
targets.verification_rule: Common-input pulse characterization; reference contributions documented

targets.name: local corrected residual channel offset
targets.verification_rule: Frozen local offsets, checked across channel pairs

targets.name: timestamp step
targets.verification_rule: Separately from measured timing jitter

targets.name: optical coincidence peak FWHM
targets.verification_rule: Report full response including tails; primary coincidence window full width 2000 ps

targets.name: peak centroid drift
targets.verification_rule: Relative to frozen calibration

targets.name: overflow sequence loss and count mismatch
targets.verification_rule: Individual 1e6-pulse tests at 1 MHz; simultaneous 1 MHz/channel test; complete archive path

targets.name: pump deviation from frozen total setpoint
targets.verification_rule: All logged samples during full run; guard band includes U_delta

targets.name: crystal temperature deviation
targets.verification_rule: Full run; sensor location, gradients and uncertainty documented

targets.name: singles per channel
targets.verification_rule: Ceiling, not operating setpoint

targets.name: ambiguous event-component fraction per setting
targets.verification_rule: M/(M+U), fixed bipartite component rule

targets.name: delayed coincidences divided by central coincidences
targets.verification_rule: Four shifted windows +-50 and +-100 ns, full width 2 ns; no primary subtraction

targets.name: detector system efficiency
targets.verification_rule: Calibrated photon flux at module input; actual wavelength; not bare sensor PDE

targets.name: dark rate upper one-sided 99 percent Poisson limit
targets.verification_rule: Per channel 600 s after stabilization; statistical bound, no extra U guard band

targets.name: dead time
targets.verification_rule: Optical recovery measurement; afterpulsing characterized separately

targets.name: conditional CHSH lower confidence bound
targets.verification_rule: L_T=2*sum(one-sided CP lower bounds alpha=.0025)-4; technical/model gates required

targets.name: calibration pair-rate reserve
targets.verification_rule: Per setting across four output combinations; no performance guarantee or replacement of 2000-pair gate

targets.name: crystal pump waist radius per axis
targets.verification_rule: Search range only; final accepted tolerances follow Gaussian/collection budget

pending_system_limits: wavelength drift from QPM and spectral budget
position and pointing drift from collection budget
CW/CCW focus and spectral overlap tolerances
